settings.mission: Our mission is to share the most comforting and nostalgic Filipino food. We source only high quality ingredients locally through other small businesses and farmers in BC to prepare and cook with love.

settings.image_alt: BBQ pork skewers grilled over charcoal, topped with garlic bits and green onions
settings.heading: Fresh off the wok, grill, and fire
settings.text: Nanay cooks Filipino comfort food in Langley for takeout, delivery, catering and events: silogs with wok-fried garlic rice, charcoal-grilled inihaw, palabok and party trays sized for every crowd.

settings.title: Local, small-business ingredients
settings.text: We source only high quality ingredients locally through other small businesses and farmers in BC.

settings.title: Free-range eggs
settings.text: Our silogs and palabok use free-range eggs from Coligny Creek Co.

settings.title: Grilled over charcoal
settings.text: Chicken inasal, liempo and skewers are marinated in-house and grilled over charcoal.

settings.heading: Let Nanay feed your people
settings.text: Order a feast online, or text us and we'll help you plan.
